services.name: Swim Team
services.desc: Recommended for beginner swimmers who need a personalized instruction to improve their swimming. Managed by certified, friendly, and experienced instructors, these classes will introduce kids to basic swimming skills at a pace they’ll feel comfortable with. It is ideal for those who are getting in the water for the first time. No. Private lessons are available for beginner swimmers of all ages.
